title: 废墟边缘
text:
{char}被军队送进了废墟的边缘，三天后来接。

这是一片没人愿意久留的地方：能翻出好东西，也随时会惊动住在里面的人。带出去的东西归你，死在里面就什么都没了。

你现在站在出发点上。地图上那枚小棋子是你，点相邻的点就是走一步；每走到一个点，那里的事就会发生。先往前走到第一个搜索点看看。

texts.en:
The army dropped {char} at the edge of the ruins. Pickup is in three days.

Nobody stays here longer than they have to. There are good things to dig up, and whatever lives inside can wake at any moment. What you carry out is yours. Die in here and you lose everything.

You're standing at the starting point. The little piece on the map is you; click an adjacent node to take one step. Whatever waits at a node happens when you arrive. Walk to the first search spot and have a look.
